source_inspection.method: Contact sheets at 5-second intervals plus 2-second details and full-size 122-second frame; ffmpeg scene threshold 0.25 over 96-180 seconds.
source_inspection.observation: Selected single-subject closeups visibly contain gesturing arms/hands; a wide-shot crop can also retain hips. Actual landmark coverage remains to be measured.
source_inspection.identity_review: Source metadata supplies the subject attribution. Visual selection does not promote speaker association or continuity review.

next_step: After remote checkpoint verification, execute the four frozen windows, preserve observations, export selected geometry and report arm coverage before fitting.
limitations: All added intervals are from the existing Goldman training event; this does not add event diversity.
The original WIRED validation result has already been observed and is not a fresh test.
